title: Compact-support transport of a Weil datum
statement:
Work in the purity conventions of [def-pur-conventions], with global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{k_0}$, and coefficient stage $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$, where $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\geq1$. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories and the operation and comparison data on the domains specified in [def-pur-conventions, def-exchange-projection]; in particular, the integral stage uses completed coefficients, and the field stages use rationalization and common finite stages.

Fix the geometric-Frobenius datum of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]: a separated finite-type morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ of finite-type $k_0$-schemes with geometric base change $f:X\to Y$ smooth of relative dimension $d$, where $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$. Write $\gamma=\sigma^{-1}$ for geometric Frobenius, where $\sigma:z\mapsto z^q$, and $g_{T,\gamma}=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for $T=X,Y$. Use the first, Cartesian square of that datum, whose horizontal arrows are $g_{X,\gamma}$ and $g_{Y,\gamma}$ and whose vertical arrows are $f$.

Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ carry a strict geometric-Weil datum in the sense of [def-pur-tate-datum], with specified isomorphism $\varphi_M:Lg_{X,\gamma}^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. Define its compact-support transport to be the composite
$$
\varphi_{f_!M}:Lg_{Y,\gamma}^*Rf_!M
\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_!(M)}Rf_!Lg_{X,\gamma}^*M
\xrightarrow{Rf_!(\varphi_M)}Rf_!M.
$$
Here $\operatorname{Ex}_!(M)$ is the compact-support exchange of [def-exchange-projection] for the first Cartesian square of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius], taken over the base scheme $S=Y$: then $X$ (via $f$), $Y$ (via the identity) and $Y'=Y$ (via $g_{Y,\gamma}$) are finite-type $S$-schemes, $f$ and the isomorphism $g_{Y,\gamma}$ are separated finite-type $S$-morphisms, and $\ell$ is invertible on $Y$; no $k$-linearity of the semilinear horizontal maps is used. Explicitly, for a chosen compactification $c=(j,p)$ of $f$ and its base change $c'=(j',p')$ along $g_{Y,\gamma}$, with $\bar g':\overline X'\to\overline X$, its finite-coefficient component is
$$
Lg_{Y,\gamma}^*Rp_*j_!M
\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}^{R}_{*,p}(j_!M)}Rp'_*L\bar g'^*j_!M
\xrightarrow{Rp'_*(\beta_M)}Rp'_*j'_!Lg_{X,\gamma}^*M.
$$
The first map is the ambient ringed pro-etale exchange of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] and $\beta_M:L\bar g'^*j_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}j'_!Lg_{X,\gamma}^*M$ is [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. Interpret the source and target via the specified compactification comparison data. At the integral stage use the completed exchange of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], and at the field stages its rationalized and common-stage forms, with the supplied comparison data of [def-exchange-projection]. These formulas use only the underlying scheme square.

For $T=X$ or $Y$ and an object $N$ on $T$ carrying a datum $\varphi_N:Lg_{T,\gamma}^*N\to N$, its scheme-Frobenius form is, by definition,
$$
u_N:=\varphi_N\circ\kappa_{T,N}:L\Phi_T^*N\longrightarrow N,
$$
where $\Phi_T$ is the base-changed $q$-power scheme Frobenius and $\kappa_{T,N}:L\Phi_T^*N\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*N$ is the comparison of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. In particular this convention applies to $N=M$ and to $N=Rf_!M$ with the transported datum displayed above.

geometric-Frobenius datum of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius],
and let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ carry a strict Weil datum
$\varphi_M:Lg_{X,\gamma}^*M\cong M$. The compact-support transport of the
datum is

$$
\varphi_{f_!M}:Lg_{Y,\gamma}^*Rf_!M
\xrightarrow{\ \operatorname{Ex}_!\ }
Rf_!Lg_{X,\gamma}^*M
\xrightarrow{\ Rf_!(\varphi_M)\ }Rf_!M,
$$

the first arrow being the compact-support base change of
[def-exchange-projection] for the first Cartesian square of
[def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Its scheme-Frobenius form is

$$
u_N=\varphi_N\circ\kappa_{T,N}:L\Phi_T^*N\longrightarrow N
$$

for every object $N$ on $T=X$ or $Y$ carrying a datum, as in
[def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius].
